card.name: Second digit of month in dates
card.fires_on: The digit after a leading 0 in a month or hour slot of a numeric date or time, such as 2011-0<<7>>-08 or 0<<2>>:34. Seen in web page timestamps, retrieval dates and URLs.

modes.label: Month digit in ISO dates
modes.description: The digit after 0 in the month slot of a year-month-day date.

modes.label: Hour digit in timestamps
modes.description: The digit after 0 in the hour slot of a time such as 02:34.

card.plain: It fires on the month digit inside a numeric date like 2011-07-08, or the hour digit in a clock time.
